speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me if you have noticed any bleeding from your gums or nose, or if the leg pain is constant or only when you move? Have you had any recent weight loss or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the patient experienced any bone pain in the arms or chest, and have you noticed any swelling or lumps that could be enlarged lymph nodes? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count

text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte Count 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet Count 27,000/mm3 (decreased).

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any palpable lymphadenopathy or hepatosplenomegaly on physical exam? REQUEST TEST: Peripheral Blood Smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy detected; Liver palpable 3 cm below the right costal margin; Spleen palpable 2 cm below the left costal margin.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are there any blast cells visible on the peripheral blood smear? REQUEST TEST: Bone Marrow Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Bone Marrow Aspirate: Predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of CD10, CD19, and TdT positive blasts in the bone marrow confirms the diagnosis of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
